newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH PX50 RISES AT FIXING LED BY SPT.
newsitem.headline: CZECH PX50 RISES AT FIXING LED BY SPT.

text.p: Czech shares rose strongly again at Wednesday's fixing on the Prague bourse but at a slightly slower pace than on Tuesday when the crown fell by almost 10 percent against the mark and dollar.

SPT Telecom was the biggest gainer among the high caps, rising 93 crowns, 2.9 percent, to 3,224. On Tuesday, SPT rose by the maximum daily allowable 8.0 percent with dealers citing the fall of the crown as the main reason.
Power utility CEZ, however, failed to sustain Tuesday's momentum when it also rose by 8.0 percent. CEZ fell seven crowns to 971.
Overall, most shares on the index rose with advancers outpacing decliners by 35 to seven.
